assembly-isolation-none.fix: Re-register the assembly in Sandbox isolation, and check its code against the sandbox limits (no GAC dependencies, HTTP and HTTPS only).
assembly-isolation-none.title: Assembly registered without isolation; Dataverse online runs plug-ins only in the sandbox

assembly-storage-online.fix: Re-register the assembly with its location set to Database (Plug-in Registration Tool, or pac plugin push).
assembly-storage-online.title: Assembly stored outside the database (on disk or the GAC), which Dataverse online cannot run

csproj-sdk-net462.fix: Retarget the project to .NET Framework 4.6.2 or later (4.8 for the newest platform features) and take Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk and Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Proxy from the Microsoft.CrmSdk.CoreAssemblies package instead of the SDK 5.0 assemblies. `crm inventory convert --source-map MAP --repo REPO` writes the SDK-style project; the assembly is rebuilt and re-registered afterwards. Judged only for an assembly the source map matches to exactly one project: an unmapped assembly is not read, and an unreadable project is unknown.
csproj-sdk-net462.title: The plug-in project targets .NET Framework below 4.6.2 or references the SDK 5.0 Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk or Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Proxy assemblies

form-handler-no-execution-context.fix: Select 'Pass execution context as first parameter' on the handler (passExecutionContext="true") and take formContext from executionContext.getFormContext() in the function. Only enabled handlers are judged; a handler whose library cannot be read is unknown, not clear.
form-handler-no-execution-context.title: An enabled form handler does not pass the execution context to a library that uses Xrm.Page

plugin-binary-sdk-net462.fix: Rebuild the assembly from its source at .NET Framework 4.6.2 or later against the Microsoft.CrmSdk.CoreAssemblies package, then re-register it. With no source, the code has to be recovered or rewritten first: `convert` has no transform for a binary. Read from the registered binary's metadata (its TargetFrameworkAttribute and assembly references), for an assembly the source map does not match to exactly one project; a mapped assembly is judged by csproj-sdk-net462 instead. A reference shows what the assembly was built against, not which code runs. An assembly with no binary in the inventory, or one that is not a readable .NET assembly, is unknown.
plugin-binary-sdk-net462.title: The registered plug-in assembly was built for .NET Framework below 4.6.2 or references the SDK 5.0 Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk or Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Proxy assemblies

plugin-source-filesystem.fix: Keep the data in Dataverse (a table, a file or image column, a web resource) or in an Azure service the plug-in calls over HTTPS instead of a local path. Path, Stream and MemoryStream are not file access and are not flagged. Detect-only: `crm inventory convert` never rewrites a C# file. Judged only for an assembly the source map matches to exactly one project, from `--source-map` and `--repo`: the project's own C# files are read, a project reached through a ProjectReference is not, and a file that cannot be read or parsed is unknown.
plugin-source-filesystem.title: The plug-in source reads or writes the file system (File, Directory, FileInfo, DirectoryInfo or FileStream), which the Dataverse online sandbox does not allow

plugin-source-registry.fix: Move the setting to the step's secure or unsecure configuration, an environment variable, or a configuration table in Dataverse. Detect-only: `crm inventory convert` never rewrites a C# file. Judged only for an assembly the source map matches to exactly one project, from `--source-map` and `--repo`: the project's own C# files are read, a project reached through a ProjectReference is not, and a file that cannot be read or parsed is unknown.
plugin-source-registry.title: The plug-in source reads or writes the Windows registry (Registry or RegistryKey), which the Dataverse online sandbox does not allow

plugin-source-sql-client.fix: Replace the direct SQL access with Dataverse Web API or IOrganizationService calls (QueryExpression, FetchXML), or move the work to a service the plug-in calls over HTTPS. The online sandbox limits a plug-in to IOrganizationService calls, Azure methods and web access. Detect-only: `crm inventory convert` never rewrites a C# file. Judged only for an assembly the source map matches to exactly one project, from `--source-map` and `--repo`: the project's own C# files are read, a project reached through a ProjectReference is not, and a file that cannot be read or parsed is unknown.
plugin-source-sql-client.title: The plug-in source opens a SQL connection (SqlConnection, SqlCommand or SqlDataAdapter), which the Dataverse online sandbox does not allow

web-resource-crmform.fix: Rewrite against the client API: crmForm.all.<attribute>.DataValue becomes formContext.getAttribute("<attribute>").getValue(). crmForm is not part of the documented 9.x client API, and only the documented API is supported. Tool judgment: no Microsoft Learn page names crmForm; the sources are the closest statements.
web-resource-crmform.title: Uses the CRM 4.0 crmForm scripting object

web-resource-xrm-page.fix: Use the form context: take executionContext.getFormContext() in a form handler (pass the execution context as the first parameter), or PrimaryControl in a ribbon command.
web-resource-xrm-page.title: Uses the deprecated Xrm.Page object
